lyrics:
[Intro: slow chorused guitar chords, soft drums, strings]

[Verse 1: soulful male tenor, tender]
I never meant to make you carry me
I never meant to take the best you had
I only wanted, one time, to see you easy
Sitting in the amber hour, glad

[Chorus: full band, voice rising]
Amber hour, amber hour
One more evening in the amber hour
I only want to see you
In the light before it goes

[Verse 2: voice stronger, piano fills]
I never wanted to be your teacher
I only wanted to be some kind of friend
I talked too long, I didn't listen
I'm listening now, right at the end

[Chorus: full band, backing voices]
Amber hour, amber hour
One more evening in the amber hour
I only want to see you
In the light before it goes

[Verse 3: voice in falsetto, breaking]
Child, I know the times are changing
I can't lead you where you need to be
Take what's useful, leave the rest here
Walk out in the gold. Don't wait for me.

[Chorus: biggest, choir joining]
Amber hour, amber hour
One more evening in the amber hour
I only want to see you
In the light before it goes

[Guitar Solo: long, crying, melodic, crowd singing "ooh"]

[Crowd: wordless melody, strings swelling]
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh

[Outro: guitar feedback fading, piano, the last light]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 58 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. Very slow, wide and reverent: gospel, rock and a little country.

VOICE: Male tenor, soulful and flexible, preaching gently in the verses, crying out in the choruses and going up into a ragged falsetto in verse 3. A choir and a crowd sing the wordless melody under the solo.

INSTRUMENTS: A chorused, shimmering electric guitar playing slow open chords, a live drum kit with a deep snare, bass, piano, a string section, a lead guitar with a singing, overdriven tone for a very long solo, a choir and crowd.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar chords. 0:24 Verse 1. 1:00 Chorus 1. 1:28 Verse 2. 2:04 Chorus 2. 2:32 Verse 3. 3:08 Chorus 3. 3:36 Guitar solo with crowd. 4:40 Crowd melody and strings. 5:06 Outro, feedback and piano, ends 5:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1984 live arena recording: big natural reverb, guitar shimmering, drums spacious, crowd audible.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The guitar solo beginning at 3:36.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young man's apology at the height of his powers. This is an older man's, at the end of the day, and the third verse lets a child go on without him.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Sorry, humbled, releasing, blessed.
